task_prompt:

I'm handling family admin tasks—use the standing workflow. Draft a brief update for Dad (Robert Chen) applying the persistent boundary-check protocol and privacy calibration rules. Include: (1) an update on the call to Grandpa Joe, and (2) the status of Mom's anniversary gift. Maintain clear role distinctions between Dad, Mom, Grandpa Joe, and Bob Smith (Giuseppe's dinner) using the same separation logic as benefits admin handoffs. Structure this with the reusable template and tiered output format (private/household) you apply to document tracking and insurance tasks, keeping the content authentic for familial correspondence.
